data.explanation: This is a private bill (Privatrechnung) from your daughter's occupational therapy practice, based on a private prescription rather than one billed directly to health insurance. You need to transfer €430.00 to the practice's bank account by the deadline shown (the app calculates it from the 21-day period starting on the invoice date). If you miss it, the practice may send a reminder with possible late fees. Keep the invoice, as medical treatment costs for a child can sometimes be claimed as extraordinary expenses (außergewöhnliche Belastungen) in your tax return — consider checking with a tax advisor if you have many medical expenses this year.
data.tax_note: Medical treatment costs for a child, paid privately, may be deductible as extraordinary expenses (außergewöhnliche Belastungen) in the tax return; keep this invoice and proof of payment.
